title: stage profile (v1)
description: Profile schema for a surface that serializes a staged fileset: a working set of files gathered for an operation, saved so it survives the session. A document claiming this profile must validate against BOTH the core surface v2 schema and this schema. The defining constraint is that every item addresses a file: a stage is a set of things, not a piece of writing about them. Documentation: docs/envelopes/surface.md.

destination.description: Where this set is proposed to go, as owner/repo[:dir]. A claim about the set, not a pending transfer: it stays true whether or not anything ever performs it. Distinct from a repo's own stage.targets, which declares where that repo accepts files and belongs in the repo's manifest.

prompts.description: Authored review asks carried with the set, each a short label and the full prompt text behind it. The richer sibling of branch-review's review_focus, which carries bare focus terms; kept separate at first meeting rather than unified on the assumption they are the same field.

target.description: Required under this profile. A staged item addresses a file, either a repository source (the {repository, ref, path} triple) or a local path-only source, which travels only when the item also carries content.

related.description: Documented relation: compares-to, naming the other side of a diff pair. An item carrying it should also carry view.mode: diff, and so should its counterpart.
